name: Ishmaelites The
overview: The Ishmaelites, descendants of Abraham's son Ishmael, are identified in Scripture as a people divided into twelve tribes, dwelling in tents and often involved in conflict with Israel. Genesis 25:13-15 lists their tribal names, highlighting their established genealogical structure. Judges 8:10-12 recounts Gideon's military actions against eastern hosts dwelling in tents, illustrating the Ishmaelites' role as adversaries to Israel while emphasizing God's sovereignty in their defeat. This biblical portrayal underscores their historical significance and foreshadows their ultimate submission to Christ.
